says: Field-only classes, structures and enumerations of the logic layer now have no kind. The rule of Policy logic routine (codekind-69151710071068370994) still sends 'plain field-only classes' to 'Data class', but that kind was renamed Dialog hand-over data class and moved to Screens, and it admits only dialog shapes. Such pieces fit nothing: PolicyLoaderSource and PolicySourceWritability enumerations (PolicyLoader.vb:238-250), the nested RegFileKey/RegFileValue (RegFile.vb:301-315), PolEntryData's field part, and the PInvokeTokenPrivileges and PInvokeLuid structures (PInvoke.vb:15-25), plus the fields of SpolPolicyState (SpolFile.vb:203-209). Write an entry in layer-75177229849285610651 for logic and interop data shapes (values that carry a policy source's contents, its kind or a Windows call's arguments), and replace the stale 'Data class' reference in the policy logic routine rule.
